comment: What make runs or spawns that knip cannot see from the manifests (scripts/kit/lint-ts.mts adds these to knip.json).

entries.docs/.vitepress/config.mts: the VitePress configuration of the site under docs/, which make docs-build runs with vitepress build docs
entries.docs/.vitepress/theme/index.ts: the VitePress theme of the site under docs/, which VitePress loads by its path
entries.tests/conformance/runner_typescript.mts: the TypeScript conformance runner, which tests/conformance/check/main.mts spawns
entries.tests/dbspec/apply/typescript.mts: the TypeScript apply runner, which the Go physical apply tests spawn
entries.tests/dbspec/compare/typescript.mts: the TypeScript compare runner, which tests/dbspec/compare/runners.mts spawns
entries.tests/dbspec/compare/check.mts: the dbspec comparison check, which make runs with node
entries.tests/dbspec/introspect/typescript.mts: the TypeScript introspect runner, which the Go physical introspect tests spawn
entries.tests/dbspec/stress.mts: the writer of the stress documents, which make runs with node
entries.tests/go-run.mts: the Go test runner, which the repository checks and the CI spawn
entries.tests/interfaces/typescript.mts: the TypeScript declaration extractor, which tests/interfaces/check spawns with its own TypeScript

packages/ts.reason: the TypeScript client @polyspec/orm, a workspace of the root package.json

entries.src/index.ts: the . export of @polyspec/orm, built to dist/index.js
entries.tests/*.mjs: the TypeScript client tests, each run by node from a make target (ts-check/test, client-unit-check, client-db-check and the feature checks of contracts/features.json)
entries.tests/*.ts: the type tests of the TypeScript client, which tsc checks through packages/ts/tsconfig.json and orm-gen scans for the models
entries.src/bin/orm-gen.ts: the orm-gen command, the bin of @polyspec/orm
entries.src/testing.ts: the ./testing export of @polyspec/orm under the orm-test condition
entries.src/tools/cli.ts: the dbspec tool command that the dbspec checks run from packages/ts/dist
entries.src/models/markdown_fixture/models.ts: the generated models of the Markdown fixture, which the markdown tests load from dist

packages/dbspec-language.reason: the dbspec language service, a workspace of the root package.json

entries.src/index.ts: the . export of @polyspec/dbspec-language, built to dist/index.js
entries.src/cli/main.ts: the dbspec-language command, built by src/cli/tsconfig.json and run by the dbspec-language checks

packages/dbspec-vscode.reason: the VS Code extension of dbspec, a workspace of the root package.json

entries.tests/integration/run.mjs: the VS Code integration test, which make dbspec-vscode-check runs
entries.tests/integration/suite/index.cjs: the suite that @vscode/test-electron loads by path from tests/integration/run.mjs

ignoreDependencies.vue: the Vue of VitePress, which the site theme (docs/.vitepress/theme/index.ts) imports; vitepress pins it
ignoreDependencies.mysql2: the MySQL driver of the TypeScript client (packages/ts), which the root's database checks import through the workspace
ignoreDependencies.pg: the PostgreSQL driver of the TypeScript client (packages/ts), which the root's database checks import through the workspace
ignoreDependencies.@polyspec/ordered-json: the ordered JSON of the TypeScript client (packages/ts), which the conformance result check imports through the workspace

binaries.sqlite3: the SQLite shell that make decimal-bench-sqlite runs (scripts/decimal-bench-sqlite.mts)
binaries.mkfifo: the POSIX tool that the tests of scripts/features/coverage and scripts/test-servers use to block a child on a pipe
binaries.brew: Homebrew, which scripts/php/php-min.mts uses to find the lowest supported PHP on macOS
binaries.rustc: the Rust compiler whose version scripts/repo/check.test.mts reads
binaries.mysql: the MySQL client that make test-servers and its tests run
binaries.mysqld: the MySQL server that make test-servers starts
binaries.pg_ctl: the PostgreSQL control tool that make test-servers runs
binaries.mysql_tzinfo_to_sql: the MySQL tool that loads the time zone tables for make test-servers
